repos_data.description: Free, open-source macOS cleaner. CleanMyMac alternative with zero telemetry. Native SwiftUI, scheduled auto-cleaning, Xcode/Homebrew/system cache cleanup. MIT licensed.
Safety-first disk cleaner and space analyzer for macOS, Windows and Linux, with duplicate cleanup, app uninstall, startup management, system optimization, and maintenance.
Free up your Mac. Safely. A free, open-source native Mac app that clears the cache and junk your Mac piles up on its own. Files go to the Trash by default, so you can put them back.
Free macOS menu bar app to visualize and clean developer caches (Xcode, node_modules, CocoaPods, SPM, Docker, pip, Cargo). Reclaim disk space instantly.
Uninstall Mac apps with every file they leave behind, and see why each belongs. Free up space, fine-tune macOS, and set up Terminal.
Free zero-telemetry CleanMyMac alternative for macOS - source-available. Native SwiftUI: app uninstaller, disk analyzer, duplicates, Xcode/Docker reclaim. (GPLv3 + Commons Clause)

Free, open-source CleanMyMac alternative for macOS. Preview disk cleanup by path and size, inspect memory by app, and quit idle apps after review. Menu bar app, CLI, Homebrew. No account or telemetry.
Free, open-source Mac cleaner: a native SwiftUI app for Mole. Clean caches, uninstall apps and their leftovers, map your disk, monitor your Mac. A CleanMyMac alternative.
Free, open-source Mac app that finds what Docker, node_modules, old IDEs and duplicate files leave behind.
面向影视创作者与开发者的 Mac 清理工具。识别 60 余款剪辑、设计与 AI 工具的缓存，一键清理，可撤销，不影响项目、素材与对话。

Free, open-source macOS disk cleaner and disk space analyzer for developers — a CleanMyMac/DaisyDisk alternative. Clean Xcode, Docker, simulators, node_modules and 40+ caches from the menu bar, and see every gigabyte in a 2D/3D treemap.
